children: ), a global cybersecurity company delivering business resilience, today announced that N-able Cove Data Protection™ has been named a Champion and the number one overall product in the Infotech 2026 Enterprise Backup Data Quadrant. The news comes as AI reshapes the threat landscape, putting greater pressure on organizations to protect critical data, recover quickly, and maintain business continuity.

Based on feedback and reviews from users, the recognition validates Cove’s approach to data resilience. The solution ranked first overall in the Enterprise Backup category with a 9/10 composite score and a 95% likelihood-to-recommend score. Cove also led the category in Business Value Created (91%) and Product Strategy and Rate of Improvement (88%).

Cove is a cloud-native data protection solution that keeps servers, workstations, and SaaS data protected and recoverable from one console. Built for MSPs and IT teams, Cove is powered by our proprietary TrueDelta™ technology, which backs up only changed data for smaller and more frequent backups. All backups are immutable, isolated, and encrypted, keeping them safe from threat actors. When an outage, cyberattack, or data loss occurs, Cove’s disaster recovery capabilities enable organizations to recover reliably and rapidly.

This recognition comes as Cove continues to gain momentum, having surpassed 4 million Microsoft 365 users and 200,000 businesses protected globally, underscoring the growing importance of SaaS data protection.

“What makes this recognition particularly meaningful is that it stems from our customers,” said Chris Groot, General Manager, Cove Data Protection at N-able. “Ranking first for likelihood-to-recommend, business value, and product strategy validates our focus on simplifying data protection and strengthening resilience. Protecting more than 4 million Microsoft 365 users is an exciting milestone, but the real story is the trust behind that number. Businesses rely on Cove to protect and recover their critical data, and our focus is on simplifying that process so MSPs and IT teams can be confident their data is available when they need it most.”
To learn more about Cove Data Protection, visit the N-able website.
